description: This PHP file contains unit tests for the ScssHelper class used in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding Service plugin. It tests various color manipulation functions such as darken, lighten, rgba conversion, and color validation.

classes.name: ScssHelperTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the ScssHelper utility, verifying color manipulation methods.

methods.name: testDarken
methods.description: Tests the darken function of the ScssHelper class with various color inputs and percentage values.

methods.name: testLighten
methods.description: Tests the lighten function of the ScssHelper class with various color inputs and percentage values.

methods.name: testRgba
methods.description: Verifies the rgba conversion method of the ScssHelper class for different opacity levels.

methods.name: testIsColor
methods.description: Checks whether the isValidColor method correctly identifies valid and invalid color strings.
